routes._comment: Component-preload.js and manifest.json keep the same names on every deploy, and the repo sends no Cache-Control of its own -- so browsers fall back to heuristic caching and a returning admin boots a build that can be weeks old. no-cache asks for revalidation rather than forbidding storage: with the repo's ETag an unchanged file still answers 304, so this costs a conditional request, not a re-download.
